label: Current US Congress, for 2024 elections
description: The US Congressional map currently in effect in Georgia, enacted by the General Assembly in December 2023 after the federal court ruling in Alpha Phi Alpha v. Raffensperger and used for the 2024 elections.

label: US Congress, 2021 - 2024
description: The Congressional map enacted by the Georgia General Assembly in 2021 and used for the 2022 elections; struck down in October 2023 as violating Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act.

label: US Congress, 2011-2021
description: The Congressional map enacted after the 2010 census and in effect from 2012 through 2020, re-scored here against 2020 census demographics for comparison.

label: US Congress, GHDC & GSDC, 2023
provenance: Georgia House and Senate Democratic Caucuses
description: Congressional remedy plan submitted jointly by the Georgia House and Senate Democratic Caucuses during the 2023 remedial proceedings following Alpha Phi Alpha v. Raffensperger.

label: US Congress, Senate Committee Chair, 2021
description: Congressional plan proposed by the Georgia Senate Reapportionment Committee Chair during the 2021 redistricting cycle.

label: US Congress, Democratic Caucuses, 2021
description: Congressional plan proposed by the Georgia Democratic Caucuses as an alternative during the 2021 redistricting cycle.

label: US Congress, Cooper remedial plan
description: Plan proposed by expert witness William S. Cooper during the 2023 federal court trial in Alpha Phi Alpha v. Raffensperger to demonstrate that an additional Black-opportunity Congressional district was feasible.

label: US Congress, Milligan-style remedy 1
description: Illustrative Congressional remedy plan drawn along the lines suggested by Allen v. Milligan to add a second majority-Black district in metro Atlanta.

label: US Congress, Milligan-style remedy 1 (2024 data)
description: The Milligan-style Congressional remedy plan re-scored against 2024 election results and updated ACS demographics.

label: US Congress, alternate proposal 3, 2021
description: An alternate Congressional draft circulated during the 2021 legislative redistricting session; not adopted.

label: US Congress, enacted 2022 (original)
description: The originally-enacted 2021 Congressional map as used in the 2022 elections, prior to the 2024 legislative update that lightly refreshed metadata.

description: The State Senate map enacted by the Georgia General Assembly in 2021 and used for the 2022 elections; superseded in 2023 following the Voting Rights Act ruling.

label: State Senate, illustrative remedy, 2023

label: State Senate, enacted 2022 (2024 update)
